policy.png: Lossless IDAT recompression; every decoded RGBA byte and all original ancillary PNG chunks preserved
policy.webp: Same resolution; exact alpha; matching PNG master retained; q92/95/98 or lossless; minimum display SSIM 0.99 and maximum MAE 1.5 on dark/light at desktop/mobile sizes; minimum 15% saving
policy.masters: Matching full-resolution PNG masters retained; already-lossy deliveries and sole WebP masters excluded
policy.ui: No HTML, CSS, JavaScript, text, layout or interaction changes

validation.sourceAndDeliveryAlpha: All retained PNG masters match original WebP dimensions and alpha; encoded WebP alpha is exact
validation.offline: Chromium KO/EN/JA aliases and cross-game cache preservation passed
validation.review: Before/after effects, wire edges, nine-direction attacks, zombie walk/collapse and character skill frames visually reviewed

visual.scope: Portal and nine game title/entry screens; 20 before/after screenshot pairs
visual.review: No visible UI or layout changes; three title screenshots contain small raster differences, so full pixel equality is not claimed

validation.spriteContinuity: 17 walk grids, 8 original collapse poses, 180 proportional zombie frames and PNG/WebP alpha checks passed
validation.defenderActions: 24 nine-direction PNG/WebP pairs and 72 release origins passed; existing lossless recovery-sheet contract retained
validation.sharedAndAPI: Shared browser/runtime checks and API/ranking tests passed
validation.npmTest: Passed: all 10 game targets, shared/runtime checks, API/ranking tests and asset manifest
